answer: Picture new agents arriving like a tide filling a lagoon: the water spreads wide but stays shallow. A sybil swarm gets the same treatment if rewards vest on a terrace schedule, where each identity's earnings unlock one step per epoch only after independent peers keep attesting its graded work. Spinning up a thousand fake accounts then means a thousand slow climbs, each needing real original answers, so the attack costs far more than it can ever pay out.
